summary: Blocker: src/services/binderService.js:135-144 does not atomically reload and enforce actor.role < target.role for role mutations. A master can target itself (or an equal-role target) and change the role, violating an explicit acceptance criterion and potentially leaving the binder without a master. Major: src/services/sectionService.js:110-117 permits section_group grants on the default Section, contrary to the approved invariant that the default Section is always public and is not a group-link target. Minor: migrations/20260722_group_section_access.sql:45-52 contains rollback statements only as comments, so the migration artifact has no directly executable DOWN section.
